marketing_description: The NUVO by SATCO S11860 Downlight is a round, recessed fixture available in a white finish and offers a range of color temperatures including 2700 K, 3000 K, 3500 K, 4000 K, and 5000 K. This dimmable LED downlight features 5 color changing temperatures and utilizes LED technology for energy efficient and long-lasting performance. It is a suitable option for a variety of applications.
